result.rationale: The migration line `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` interpolates the raw site-setting value verbatim. The model normalizes hosts (strips http://, paths) via before_validation, but migration bypasses it, so hosts stored as 'http://foo.com' are inserted as-is while `record_for_host` matches `lower(host) = uri.host` (bare hostname), causing silent mismatch; a value containing a single quote breaks the INSERT/SQL. Both mechanisms are verifiable in the diff.
